step_token_key: a long random key: openssl rand -hex 32, or the PowerShell line in docs/getting-started.md
claude_model_token: Claude Code installation only: the token `claude setup-token` prints, or an Anthropic API key with auth: api_key
copilot_github_token: Copilot CLI installation only: a fine-grained GitHub token with the Copilot Requests permission
github_app_key: only if the installation uses key_ref in place of key_path: the GitHub App's private key, with newlines as \n
